findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: violation_dismissal_rates, denial_clock, screening_dispute, nyc_ticket · Private data: popla_outcomes, violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, search_mtd_answers, parking_route, denial_clock, screening_dispute, nyc_ticket · Public sink: violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, parking_route, screening_dispute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: violation_dismissal_rates, denial_clock, screening_dispute, nyc_ticket · Private data: popla_outcomes, violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, search_mtd_answers, parking_route, denial_clock, screening_dispute, nyc_ticket · Public sink: violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, parking_route, screening_dispute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
